about: What WorkProof.scan(record, headLen) of launches/b-desk/src/proof answers for record bytes that are well formed, subtly wrong, or mutated at random. 'result' is 'ok:' followed by keccak256(abi.encode(bytes16 jobId, bytes32 recordHash, bytes32 kindHash, bytes32 headHash, bytes32 specHash, bytes32 stateHash, uint256[] agentIds)), or 'err:' followed by the revert data (selectors, as `cast sig` gives them: Malformed(uint256) 0x45ef4133 followed by the byte offset, MissingKey() 0x6daf24f7, WrongSchema() 0x21b8eeb9, HeadTooLong() 0x75c27a79). The expected values were produced by the Solidity contract in a Foundry test over 6,084 cases on 11 Oct 2026 (JsonScan.sol and WorkProof.sol as they stood that day, with the rule that a signal ending in ,"value":0} names no agent); this file keeps every hand-written case and an evenly spaced sample of the mutations. scanWorkRecord in this package must give the same answer for each.

compared.rule: scannerSha256 is the SHA-256 of src/workRecord.ts; casesSha256 of the generated cases.json; each contractCode entry holds, per file of launches/b-desk/src/proof, the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 source after removing /* */ and // comments and all whitespace. Every entry is a version of the contract that was run over all the cases, not only the sample below, and agreed with this scanner on every one.
